title: Long-task state
description: Persist task state and resume only from verified evidence.
purpose: Keep long-running work recoverable across interruption and context changes.
requirements: long-task-state/ledger: Maintain a durable task ledger with status, scope, owner, commands, evidence, blockers, and next action.
long-task-state/checkpoint: Checkpoint task state and material evidence before compaction, handoff, or any interruption.
long-task-state/resume-verified: Resume from verified filesystem and command state, not stale conversation memory.
long-task-state/continue-or-stop: After resuming, recheck dependencies and stop on contradictory status, missing evidence, or changed scope.
invariants: Maintain a durable task ledger, checkpoint before compaction, and resume from verified filesystem state.
